notes.title: Patch version 1.0.4.1 (for the speed runners)
notes.notes:
Bug fix update number 3, which fixes the following bugs: ːsteamhappyː

[list]
[*] play time matches in the finale and credits.
[*] killing the Drummer during phase 1 doesn't lock the arena.
[*] the Pianist doesn't get lost anymore, when phase 2 starts.
[*] glow transition always fades out.
[*] the Wisp Queen will not be blocked by dead sheep anymore ;)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.3.0
notes.notes:
Another mini bug fix update :nahbl:

bug fixes:
[list]
[*] fixed a bug, where heavy objects could block/softlock Lila while climbing on ladders.
[*] increased drop angle of mini-printers, so items don't clutter so much.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.2.1.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added quick grab action (default button RT or R-Key/middle mouse) to quickly grab a selected item from the backpack. If no item is selected, the next attack-item is auto-selected.
[/list]

The new action should make combat feel much faster, since you don't have to open the backpack all the time.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Here is a small bug fix update :broflex:

bug fixes:
[list]
[*] sometimes spirit fruits didn't respawn after loosing them
[*] the Bolshie boot could get stuck on an island
[*] honey droplet could crash the cauldron
[*] minor adjustments
[/list]

new features:
[list]
[*] added option to disable the paint-effect in the config-file
[/list]

notes.title: Hop Aboard Lila’s Sky Ark Before Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40056258/e3c3e3a44a70549a29f55211719bb124e5d8173d.jpg[/img]

Deep below the waves and high above the clouds, Lila’s mysterious journey awaits. 
Be one of the first players to explore her psychedelic world and start unraveling 
Lila’s strange-yet-beautiful story by joining our playtest of the new demo. We’d 
appreciate your help uncovering bugs, balancing issues, and anything else that has 
no place in Lila’s world. If you’d like to participate in the playtest, please head to the
link below to join the official Lila’s Sky Ark Discord.

>>>[url=https://discord.com/invite/dN6ZvnpzhX]APPLY HERE[/url]<<<

We’re using the Lila’s Sky Ark Discord to notify those who are selected for the 
playtest and for feedback collection. The playtest will run for one week, so be sure 
to get in your request to the playtesting channel as soon as possible. In celebration 
of all things Lila, Graffiti Games and Gamer Advantage are also holding a Doctor-
Father-Sir glasses contest, so be sure to follow [url=https://twitter.com/Graffiti_Games]Graffiti Games[/url] on Twitter to find out how to enter.
